title: The Defeated Warrior Princess, Taken Captive
overview: Serafina, a knight from the Illdoren Kingdom fighting in an eastern expedition, meets her match.

title: Fear of the Unknown
overview: Veor shows Serafina a small part of his life, leading to no small bit of culture shock.

title: To Be a Warrior is To Be a Hypocrite
overview: Veor intends on introducing Sera to more of the tribe, but the cultural exchange is suddenly interrupted.

title: A Drinking Party Clears the Fog
overview: Sera is introduced to the chiefs of the other tribes, who are not what she expected.

title: Hands that Pray For Coming Conflict
overview: A party headed by a retinue priest from the eastern expedition shows up, looking to "rescue" Sera.

title: Man-Made Disasters
overview: Sera works with Veor and the barbarians to overcome the Fiend, before having an unexpected reunion.

title: Flows to Purify Corruption
overview: Sera and Malcius witness the ritual to undo the damage caused by the Fiend.

title: A Contract in the Form of a Collaring
overview: After her engagement necklace comes off, Sera tries to find a way to put back on.

title: Visions Upon the Scales of the Soul
overview: With Sera feeling conflicted, Veor offers a suggestion to help her gain perspective.

title: Steam Veils the Foothills
overview: Sera and her group arrive at the Quefto city of Furnace Ridge.

title: Discovery is the Mother of All Quefto
overview: Sera learns the incredible inspiration behind the Quefto's curiosity.

title: The Crimson Warrior of Glory
overview: Sera and Veor, with a cohort of Quefto, do battle against the fearsome Guren Nairi!
